messages:
alex: Hey - seeing a provisioning spike in us-west-2 starting ~02:11 UTC. Lots of nodes failing healthchecks after OOB proxy auth rebind. BMCs are reporting boot-mode flips from UEFI -> legacy intermittently. Anyone triaging?

priya: Yep noticed that too, racks r12-r18 mostly. GPU allocation failing on dockers with kernel panics.

sam: Logs look like proxy auth timed out then BMC reconnected and applied default boot policy. snippet: `Mar 12 02:11:23 bmc-321 ipmi: auth rebind from proxy-03, session reset`

marcus: Ops-bot created INC-2026-042 - link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042 :eyes:

lina: Quick check, are these nodes on the new management proxy rollout? I think proxy-03 had an auth refresh push at ~02:10.

alex: Yes, proxy-03 was in the canary group. We rolled a token rotation earlier. Might be binding to an old CA chain for a few seconds.

sam: Repro command we used locally: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> -U admin -P **** mc info` then `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5` shows bootmode=legacy on affected hosts.

marcus: Immediate mitigation: pause the OOB proxy rollout to remaining regions and revert proxy-03 to previous cert. Also add a temporary rule to treat bootmode toggles as non-destructive (don't force reboot).

lina: I'll pause the rollout now. On it.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by marcus. Priority: P2. Affected region: us-west-2.

priya: If we need a fast workaround, we can push a non-disruptive ipmitool set to force UEFI on reconnect: `for host in $(cat affected.txt); do ipmitool -I lanplus -H $host -U admin -P **** chassis bootdev pxe options=efiboot; done` — needs rate limiting.

marcus: Good. But watch serial buffers — we had console IO lag last time at scale. Use stagger of 10s between hosts and monitor `dmesg` on the provisioning fleet.

alex: Also seeing a cost impact: fallback to smaller GPU pools in other regions while us-west-2 capacity degrades. CTO asked for estimate of delta spend for next 24h.

lina: I can pull the allocation diff now. Preliminary: ~12% more on ondemand GPUs in eu-west-1 for redispatch.

oncall: Triage checklist I ran: 1) pause rollout (done) 2) revert proxy cert (in progress) 3) schedule staggered ipmitool UEFI set for affected hosts 4) monitor provisioning queue and autoscaler 5) prepare rollback of any BMC firmware changes.

sam: After we force UEFI, watch for persistent NVMe timeout on two hosts r14-3 and r15-7 — they had post-boot NVMe IO hangs; might need a power-cycle.

priya: I'll coordinate a controlled power-cycle window for those two.

marcus: Longer term action items: 1) add a noop bootmode during OOB reconnect to avoid flip, 2) add cert-rotation canary with simulated reconnects, 3) autoscaler rule to avoid draining us-west-2 until stable.

alex: Thanks all. Lina, ping when rollback completes. I'll fill cost impact into the incident ticket.

lina: Rolled back proxy-03 cert at 02:32 UTC. Watchers please report nodes still showing legacy.

priya: r12-1/2/3 still legacy; kicking the staged ipmitool set now with 10s stagger.

ops-bot: Update INC-2026-042: mitigation in progress, affected hosts 18, estimated recovery window 45m.

oncall: Marking incident as monitoring. If we see >5% node churn or >2 sustained provisioning failures/min, escalate to P1.

alex: Monitoring shows GPUs coming back slowly. Thanks everyone.

marcus: Filed follow-ups in #eng-infra-playbooks: add canary test and non-destructive bootmode flag.

lina: Closing loop: proxy rollout will resume after a simulated reconnect runbook is added.
